_comment: CONFIRMATION + CONTROLS for the qwen3-4b v_IH phase-gating win (pre=16 > baseline=13 > post=11 > all=10, hand-verified once). This re-runs everything on the SAME cached searches as the original phase grid (search cache copied in by run_experiment4.sh) so differences isolate steering, not search variance. Key additions: a FRESH baseline run (to compare generations vs the original baseline = reproducibility/determinism check) and the missing PERTURBATION CONTROLS (random vector, turn-1-only AND always-on). If random_pre also beats baseline, the 'win' is just turn-1 perturbation, not v_IH.
